news_items.headline: Singapore and Malaysia test emergency readiness for the RTS Link.
news_items.context: The cross-border exercise covered firefighting, medical triage and evacuation ahead of passenger services.

news_items.headline: Singapore reports stronger take-up of mid-career training support.
news_items.context: By June, about eighty thousand people had used the mid-career credit and more than eleven thousand had received a training allowance.
news_items.evidence_caveat: October 28 speech reports cumulative figures to June 30, not new enrolments this month.

news_items.headline: Singapore and the United States publish preliminary findings on regional power connections.
news_items.context: The study focuses on cross-border rules and financing for an ASEAN electricity grid, with a final report due early next year.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Preliminary study findings, not a newly operating grid.

news_items.headline: Cyclone Arnab makes landfall in Andhra Pradesh.
news_items.context: Officials reported at least three deaths after the storm crossed the coast, with large-scale evacuations already carried out.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Material follow-up to landfall forecast: actual landfall and reported deaths. IMD forecast weakening must not be described as observed.

news_items.headline: India raises the dearness allowance for central-government staff and pensioners.
news_items.context: The Cabinet approved a three-percentage-point increase to sixty-three percent, effective from July.

news_items.headline: A new village-governance programme wins Cabinet approval.
news_items.context: The five-year Viksit Gram Swaraj scheme provides about seventy-four hundred crore rupees for local planning, training and digital accountability.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Approved outlay is 7395.55 crore through FY2030–31; benefits are prospective.

news_items.headline: The Cabinet backs domestic container and sports-goods manufacturing.
news_items.context: The approved schemes allocate ten thousand crore rupees to containers and about eighteen hundred and fifty-seven crore to sports equipment.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Distinct schemes with different time horizons; allocations, not measured manufacturing output.

news_items.headline: Modi and Congress clash over paper-ballot election results.
news_items.context: After Modi highlighted Congress losses in legislative-council contests, Congress challenged him to use paper ballots in future national and assembly elections.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Attributed political claims and response; no endorsement of election-fraud allegations. Congress response verified through indexed full publisher text; direct open failed.

news_items.headline: Britain’s Budget raises the bank surcharge and offers household energy relief.
news_items.context: The surcharge will rise from three to six percent for fifteen months, while eligible English households receive a hundred-pound council-tax rebate.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Bank surcharge starts January 2027; rebate targets council-tax bands A–D. Consolidates overlapping upstream budget stories.

news_items.headline: The same Budget commits further support to defence and Ukraine.
news_items.context: It completes funding for the fifteen-billion-pound defence plan and adds over ten billion pounds of support for Ukraine, including guarantees and export credit.
news_items.evidence_caveat: The £15bn plan was announced in June; this Budget confirms the remaining £4.7bn funding. Ukraine support includes guarantees and export credit, not only cash aid.

news_items.headline: Israel’s partial election count leaves both main blocs short of a majority.
news_items.context: With more than eighty-five percent counted, Netanyahu’s bloc had fifty-three seats and Eisenkot’s forty-eight, against sixty-one needed to govern.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Partial count, not final result. New fact versus previously delivered exit polls; snapshot October28 15:07 local.

news_items.headline: The Federal Reserve holds US interest rates.
news_items.context: The ten-to-two vote kept the target range at three-point-seven-five to four percent; both dissenters preferred a quarter-point increase.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Released October28 14:00EDT = October29 02:00Singapore. No claim of a promised December hike.

news_items.headline: Microsoft reports strong cloud growth.
news_items.context: Quarterly revenue reached ninety-two-point-three billion dollars, with Azure revenue up forty-eight percent.

news_items.headline: Alphabet’s cloud revenue more than doubles.
news_items.context: Google Cloud revenue reached thirty-point-seven billion dollars, up one hundred and three percent, although an equity-investment loss weighed on group profit.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Company-issued release syndicated by Publicnow/MarketScreener; direct investor site shell did not expose the release. Corrects upstream approximately90% to103%.

news_items.headline: UPS raises its full-year outlook.
news_items.context: The delivery company reported twenty-two-point-nine billion dollars in quarterly revenue and lifted its revenue and adjusted-earnings guidance.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Unseen catch-up item published October27, not overnight.

news_items.headline: PolicyMe introduces an AI copilot for complex life-insurance underwriting.
news_items.context: The company reports a fifty-nine percent reduction in turnaround time, while underwriters retain final approval; the result has not been independently verified.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Company-issued BusinessWire announcement, not an independent efficacy study. No published sample size/control methodology. Practical relevance: document review and draft explanations, not autonomous acceptance.

news_items.headline: Formula One’s Mexico practice gives the next generation track time.
news_items.context: Nikola Tsolov and Freddie Slater are set for their first Formula One practice outings.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Upcoming practice, not a completed session; official F1 source confirms the two debuts.

news_items.headline: Alcaraz and Zverev win their Vienna openers.
news_items.context: Zverev saved four match points against Martin Landaluce, while Alcaraz beat Karen Khachanov in straight sets.
news_items.evidence_caveat: AFP original reporting syndicated by FMT. Published October28 about October27 matches; unseen catch-up, not a verified quarter-final update.

news_items.headline: Europe’s Hera probe resolves its two asteroid targets separately.
news_items.context: New images distinguish Didymos from its smaller companion Dimorphos as the spacecraft approaches the system.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Unseen October27 publication; distinct from previously covered braking manoeuvre. Avoid inconsistent weekday/image-date wording in source.

news_items.headline: New research estimates widespread CTE in a cohort of deceased NFL players.
news_items.context: The model estimated signs in about three-quarters of former players who died from 2008 to 2023, not the risk faced by today’s players.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Model-based adjusted estimate74.5%, not autopsy confirmation in every member of cohort; 387 donated brains,362 positive. Do not generalize to living players.

news_items.headline: Singapore demands independent assessments from companies in its haze inquiry.
news_items.context: After meeting company leaders, Grace Fu said they must engage assessors at their own expense; proposed legal amendments will go before Parliament.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Material new meeting and assessor framework, distinct from earlier notices and expert-panel announcement. Companies are potentially connected; no guilt finding. Amendments not enacted. Haze does not count toward substantive local variety.

news_items.headline: The Netherlands pledges fresh military and civilian support for Ukraine.
news_items.context: The announced packages provide five hundred million euros in military aid and one-point-two billion euros for needs including energy, water, health care and demining.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Official Ukrainian presidency account of October28 meeting. New pledges, not confirmation all funds disbursed. The same source says talks expected by November10, not confirmed November6–10 dates.

news_items.headline: Jio Platforms ends its stock-market debut well above its issue price.
news_items.context: The shares closed at fourteen hundred and nineteen rupees, nearly twenty-seven percent above the IPO price and four-and-a-half percent above their opening level.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Material actual first-day closing price, distinct from prior IPO opening/subscription/listing expectation. Original NDTVProfit full text retrieved directly; direct exchange closing bulletin not verified. Percentages have different denominators, not27percent intraday.

news_items.headline: Apple unveils a touchscreen MacBook Pro.
news_items.context: The new OLED-display models use M five Pro and Max chips, with preorders already open and availability from November sixth.
news_items.evidence_caveat: Corrects upstream pre-order date October30 to official October28; M6 refresh was separate.

news_items.headline: Nvidia joins a fourteen-million-US-dollar funding round for India’s Simplismart.
news_items.context: Dallas Venture Capital led the Series B for the AI-inference software company, alongside Accel, Shastra and Micromax.
